# GAIA by Sanson Floorings

> GAIA by Sanson Floorings is an Indian maker of carpet tiles, broadloom carpets, acoustic PET panels and artificial grass, based in New Delhi and part of Sanson Group. It supplies offices, hotels, restaurants, schools, homes and sports facilities across India.

- Name: GAIA by Sanson Floorings (also known as GAIA; Sanson Floorings)
- Address: B-5B, Plot No. 70, 1st Floor, Rama Road Industrial Area, New Delhi 110015, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 99109 21119
- Email: contact@sansonfloorings.com
- Website: https://sansonfloorings.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/gaia-by-sanson-floorings/

## Products

- [Carpet Tiles Made in India, GreenPro Certified](https://sansonfloorings.com/categories/carpet-tiles): GreenPro-certified carpet tiles made in India by GAIA, in collections including Aangan, Miami, Naqsh and Signature, with custom backing, pile and yarn options.
- [Broadloom Carpets Made in India, Bespoke](https://sansonfloorings.com/categories/broadloom-carpets): Tufted broadloom carpets made in India in wide rolls for seamless wall-to-wall installation, customised in fibre, backing, texture, colour and pattern.
- [Acoustic PET Panels Made in India, GreenPro](https://sansonfloorings.com/categories/acoustic-tiles): GreenPro-certified acoustic PET panels made from recycled polyester: 9–24 mm thick, NRC 0.3 fixed directly and 0.85–0.90 with an air gap behind them.
- [Artificial Grass and Multiturf Made in India](https://sansonfloorings.com/categories/artificial-multiturf): Artificial grass and multiturf made in India with UNE 14836 certified yarn from Bellinturf: landscape, sports, multisport and curly grass.
- [Landscape Grass for Gardens, Terraces and Lawns](https://sansonfloorings.com/artificial-grass/landscape-grass): GAIA Landscape Grass for gardens, terraces, villas, rooftops, hotel lawns and public parks, with a choice of pile heights, stitch options and backing colours.
- [Sports Grass for Football and Athletic Fields](https://sansonfloorings.com/artificial-grass/sports-grass): GAIA Sports Grass for football, rugby, athletic training fields and school grounds, built for performance and resilience.
- [MultiTurf for Tennis, Badminton and Gym Floors](https://sansonfloorings.com/artificial-grass/multisports-grass): GAIA MultiTurf for tennis, badminton, gym floors and skating zones: a compact multi-use surface balancing performance and value.
- [Curly Grass for Balconies, Walkways and Borders](https://sansonfloorings.com/artificial-grass/curly-grass): GAIA Curly Grass has a textured, thatched look for balconies, walkways, retail display zones and garden borders.

## Company

- [About GAIA by Sanson Floorings | Sanson Group since 1982](https://sansonfloorings.com/about-us): GAIA is the flooring and acoustics label of Sanson Group, serving clients since 1982, with GreenPro-certified acoustic PET panels and carpet tiles.
- [TilesView Visualiser | See GAIA Flooring in Your Room](https://sansonfloorings.com/tools): Upload a photo of your room and preview GAIA carpet tiles, artificial grass, acoustic panels and broadloom carpets in your own space.

- [Should Acoustic Panels Have an Air Gap? NRC, Depth and Wall Lights](https://sansonfloorings.com/blogs/acoustic-panels-air-gap): Should acoustic panels have an air gap? GAIA PET panels go from NRC 0.3 fixed flat to 0.85–0.90 with a gap. How it works and how to plan lights around it.
- [Does Artificial Grass Fade in the Sun? What Indian Summers Do to Turf](https://sansonfloorings.com/blogs/does-artificial-grass-fade-in-the-sun): Does artificial grass fade in the sun? Why UV fades synthetic turf, how GAIA Landscape Grass resists it, and the site factors that make fading faster.
- [Carpet Tiles vs Carpet Planks: Sizes, Layouts and How to Choose](https://sansonfloorings.com/blogs/carpet-tiles-vs-carpet-planks): Carpet tiles vs carpet planks: GAIA 50 × 50 cm tiles and 25 × 100 cm planks compared on size, coverage, layouts such as herringbone, and which suits your room.
- [Printed Acoustic Panels: How to Light a Feature Wall](https://sansonfloorings.com/blogs/printed-acoustic-panels-feature-wall-lighting): Custom printed acoustic panels from GAIA: 9–24 mm PET on 1220 × 2440 mm sheets, NRC up to 0.90 and your own artwork, plus how to fix and light them.
